photos.alt: Barge deck loaded with piles of shell and limestone cultch, a crewman working the water cannons
photos.caption: Bedding material staged on the barge, paid for with carbon credits.

photos.alt: A hand holding two pieces of river rock with young oyster spat cemented to them
photos.caption: River rock back off the bottom of lease 30260 — new spat already cemented on.

photos.alt: A pile of river rock on deck, nearly every piece carrying young oyster spat
photos.caption: A deck sample of placed rock: spat on nearly every piece.

photos.alt: Survey dredge basket full of oysters being hauled aboard at the boat's rail
photos.caption: A density sample comes aboard for the count.

photos.alt: A dredge tow of live oysters in clusters on the boat's sorting table
photos.caption: A tow off a mature reef on the sorting table — live oysters in clusters.

photos.alt: Close-up of crushed recycled concrete used as cultch
photos.caption: Recycled crushed concrete, headed back to the water as cultch.

photos.alt: Commercial oyster boats working a lease at dawn
photos.caption: The working fleet at dawn. The restoration is done by the same boats that fish it.

photos.alt: A handful of live oysters pulled from a restored reef
photos.caption: A handful of live oysters off restored bottom.

photos.alt: A large stockpile of oyster shell awaiting return to the water as cultch
photos.caption: Shell staged shoreside, weighed and logged before it moves.

photos.alt: An oyster reef growing underwater among seagrass in clear water
photos.caption: The point of all of it: living reef, underwater and working.

photos.alt: View from the wheelhouse of a working oyster boat
photos.caption: From the wheelhouse, running out to the lease.

photos.alt: Panorama of the working dock at the water's edge
photos.caption: The dock where the survey days start and end.

photos.alt: Map of thousands of colored polling points outlining reef across two oyster leases
photos.caption: Thousands of soundings plotted — dense enough that the reef outlines itself.
